description: UK: Inheritance Tax on an estate including unused pensions, for deaths on or after 6 April 2027.

beneficiaryRate.description: Beneficiary's marginal income tax rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.4 (default 0.4)

estate.description: Everything else in the estate (home, savings, investments) less debts, GBP

homeToDescendants.description: Value of the home (or share) left to children or grandchildren, GBP (default 0)

pensions.description: Unused pension pots plus lump sum death benefits, excluding death in service from current work, GBP

toSpouse.description: Amount left to a spouse or civil partner (exempt), GBP (default 0)

transferred.description: Share of a late spouse's unused bands transferred, 0 to 1 (default 0)

name: uk_pension_inheritance_tax_2027
